query:
SELECT e.from_table || ':' || e.from_id AS of_the_canon, e.to_star || '/' || e.to_table || ':' || e.to_id AS thing, coalesce(t.says, '') AS says
FROM edges e LEFT JOIN things t ON t.id = e."to"
WHERE e.how = 'shown_in' AND e.from_table IN ('principles', 'architectures', 'practices') AND e.from_star = 'software-engineering-canon'
ORDER BY e.from_table, e.from_id, thing
title: shown in what was decided or said ({count})

lays_out: {all_of_them} principles and architectures; {shown} say where they are shown
query:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM things WHERE of_table IN ('principles', 'architectures') AND star = 'software-engineering-canon') AS all_of_them,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT "from") FROM edges WHERE how = 'shown_in' AND from_table IN ('principles', 'architectures') AND from_star = 'software-engineering-canon') AS shown

SELECT 'ocoeco focus around@' || thing || '   # ' || says AS text FROM (SELECT thing, min(seq) AS first, arg_min(says, seq) AS says FROM plane WHERE kind = 'line' AND coalesce(thing, '') <> '' GROUP BY thing) ORDER BY first

query: SELECT path, looks, scale, of_thing, says, title FROM (SELECT 'index.html' AS path, 'front' AS looks, 'every place observed' AS scale, '' AS of_thing, 'the whole: this observatory''s sheet, the perfect form, and every lens over every place in view' AS says, 'The fulldome' AS title UNION ALL SELECT 'places/' || place || '.html', 'around@' || id, 'a place', id, coalesce(says, ''), star FROM things WHERE of_table = 'places') ORDER BY path
title: the whole, and a page for each place ({count})

query: SELECT 'signs/' || place || '/' || substr(id, length(place) + length(of_table) + 3) || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || id AS looks, star AS scale, id AS of_thing, star, coalesce(says, '') AS says, 'A sign' AS title FROM things WHERE of_table = 'problems' ORDER BY path
title: a page for each sign ({count})

query: SELECT 'form/' || substr(t.id, length(t.place) + length(t.of_table) + 3) || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || t.id AS looks, 'an angle of the perfect form' AS scale, t.id AS of_thing, coalesce(t.says, '') AS says, i.heading AS title FROM things t JOIN idea i ON i.star = t.star AND i.id = substr(t.id, length(t.place) + length(t.of_table) + 3) WHERE t.of_table = 'idea' AND t.star = 'ecosystem' ORDER BY path
title: a page for each angle of the perfect form ({count})

query: SELECT 'decisions/' || t.place || '/' || substr(t.id, length(t.place) + length(t.of_table) + 3) || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || t.id AS looks, t.star AS scale, t.id AS of_thing, t.star, coalesce(t.says, '') AS says, 'A decision' AS title FROM things t WHERE t.of_table = 'decisions' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges e WHERE e."to" = t.id AND e.from_table = 'problems') ORDER BY path
title: a page for each decision a sign came to ({count})

query: SELECT d.star, count(*) AS files, CAST(sum(d.lines) AS BIGINT) AS in_all, count(t.name) AS titled FROM documents d LEFT JOIN titles t ON t.star = d.star AND t.path = d.path GROUP BY d.star ORDER BY sum(d.lines) DESC, d.star
title: what each place has written down ({count})

query: SELECT d.star, d.path, d.lines, coalesce(t.name, '(begins with no heading)') AS title, d.star || '/documents:' || d.path AS thing FROM documents d LEFT JOIN titles t ON t.star = d.star AND t.path = d.path ORDER BY d.lines DESC, d.star, d.path LIMIT 30
title: the documents, the longest first ({count})

lays_out: {files} documents, {in_all} lines, in {places} places; {titled} begin by saying what they are
query: SELECT count(*) AS files, CAST(sum(d.lines) AS BIGINT) AS in_all, count(DISTINCT d.star) AS places, (SELECT count(*) FROM titles) AS titled FROM documents d
SELECT id, name, kind, CASE WHEN coalesce(also, '') <> '' THEN ' - also ' || also ELSE '' END AS known FROM people ORDER BY seq
